aiTitle: Choose the database for the shop backend

message.content: We need to pick the database for the shop backend before the first sprint ends. I looked at Postgres and MongoDB. Our orders, invoices and stock levels are relational, and a checkout has to update all three in one transaction, so I decided we go with Postgres. MongoDB would force us to rebuild transactions by hand.

content.text: Understood. I will take that into account.

message.content: One more constraint: the team only knows SQL, and the hosting provider offers managed Postgres with daily backups. Let us use Alembic for migrations so every schema change is reviewed in a pull request. Please draft the first migration with the tables orders, order_items and products.

content.text: Understood. I will take that into account.
